categories.name: Face
categories.intro: Unhurried facials, shaped around your skin on the day.

services.name: CALÉIRA Signature Facial
services.description: A personalized European-inspired facial that cleanses, exfoliates, hydrates, and nourishes. Includes a customized skin assessment, gentle exfoliation, a relaxing facial massage, a targeted mask, and finishing skincare.
services.idealFor: Guests who want fresh, healthy-looking skin and a steady skincare routine.

image.alt: A soft brush sweeping a glossy mask across a guest's cheek, eyes closed.

services.name: CALÉIRA Facial Sculpt
services.description: A sculpting facial with targeted massage techniques and deep hydration, designed to leave you feeling relaxed with a refreshed, rested look.
services.idealFor: Special events and a little extra facial relaxation.

image.alt: A provider resting both hands along a guest's collarbone in a candlelit treatment room.

categories.name: Massage
categories.intro: Slow hands and full attention, from first touch to last.

services.name: CALÉIRA Signature Massage
services.description: A 90-minute full-body massage with pressure tailored to you, flowing movements and attentive care. An unhurried escape designed for deep relaxation.
services.idealFor: Guests who want a long, unhurried hour and a half to unwind.

image.alt: A provider cradling a guest's neck and shoulder with both hands in a candlelit room.

categories.name: Body
categories.intro: Hands-on sculpting sessions for the body, calm and unhurried.
categories.note: Body contouring is cosmetic. Individual experiences vary.

services.name: CALÉIRA Sculpt 360° Brazilian Experience
services.description: A signature Brazilian-inspired bodywork session that pairs rhythmic massage with cosmetic sculpting techniques. Designed for deep relaxation and a temporarily more refined-looking silhouette. This is a cosmetic service, not a medical one.
services.idealFor: Guests who want full-body relaxation with a sculpting focus.

image.alt: Two hands smoothing cream across a guest's shoulder beside a folded white towel.
